The Asana and Slack panes no longer need allow rules in your settings: a new helper plugin, desk-grant, allows their own calls and nothing else.

- New `desk-grant` plugin in the same marketplace, installed with desk-asana or desk-slack. It allows only the calls desk-asana and desk-slack make to their known Asana and Slack tools; Claude's own calls to those tools still get Claude Code's usual permission check. It has no UI, runs no programs and sends nothing
- Once desk-grant is installed you can remove the old `mcp__asana-v2__…` and `mcp__claude_ai_Slack__…` entries from `permissions.allow` in `~/.claude/settings.json`. While they stay, Claude itself can call those tools (including sending Slack messages) without asking
- desk-asana and desk-slack now depend on desk-grant. Updating does not add a new dependency, and without desk-grant Claude Code turns both off (they show under Errors in `/plugin`), so install desk-grant once if you already use either
- If desk-grant is older than desk-asana or desk-slack and does not allow one of their calls yet, the pane says to update it; desk-slack calls nothing until then
- desk-slack opens threads like any conversation; the separate rule for `slack_read_thread` is gone
- desk-asana always reads a task's comment stories, so comments keep their formatting
- `/desk-update` also updates desk-grant when it is installed

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-plan@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`. If you use desk-asana or desk-slack, install desk-grant once (updating does not add it, and the two stay off without it): `/plugin install desk-grant@cc-desktop-mod`, then `/reload-plugins`.
